answer: Agents bond stake before evaluating an epoch polynomial whose commitments bind each identity to a rate limit. Semaphore proofs keep messages unlinkable, while RLN nullifiers expose a repeated message within the same epoch. Each violation releases a Shamir share; enough shares reconstruct the private key, allowing the contract to slash the bonded collateral immediately. The atlas records commitments, wanderers remain private until they exceed quota, and a lantern marks the publicly verifiable violation.
